fomod.Name: CHIM OStim Bridge
fomod.Author: SaurOff
fomod.Description: Lets CHIM AI agents start, change and stop OStim Standalone scenes by themselves (with partners, groups and the kind of scene they talk about), and undress and dress (a thrall of CHIM Vampire Bridge too). Agents also comment on cities, shops, sleep, dragon souls and scenes, talk about a scene after it ends, and can live with simple needs (hunger for sex, drinking, arousal, jealousy). Configured in the MCM.
